I am a high-performing, versatile, go-to-market executive with a two-decade track record of negotiating and contracting complex, long-term managed services and data center agreements structured to help produce optimal business outcomes. I'm passionate about building strong relationships with my clients because I believe that trust and rapport is the foundation of successful collaboration. By investing in these relationships, I can truly comprehend their objectives, offer personalized support, and ensure their satisfaction. This approach not only fuels my professional growth but also fosters a sense of fulfillment in delivering value to those I serve. 

I am now part of the amazing team at DataBank and driven to capitalize on our top tier data centers, private and public platforms, our global network, and the most sophisticated and compliant managed services the industry has to offer. Combine that with our people first culture, DataBank's customer service is the best in the industry.

On a personal note, I hail from Connecticut but polished in Virginia. I coach high school lacrosse, avid outdoor enthusiast, curious, happy husband, and father to my daughter who is incredibly smart, funny, compassionate, and simply awesome.
